checks.fix: Encode the control inside a principal derived rule that covers its branch, or precisely defer the branch.

checks.fix: Declare each source-stated fact as its own document-root `inputs` entry (a sibling of `module` and `rules`) or canonical import, combine them in a derived Judgment with formula proof, and test each gate.

checks.why: An aggregate input that stands for several source-stated facts hides the conditions from tests and from callers, so a wrong answer on one gate cannot be seen.

checks.fix: Encode the branch in a rule that cites it (source path or proof excerpt from its own text), or add a precise `module.deferred_outputs` entry for that branch. Descendant citations do not cover a substantive parent chapeau.

checks.why: The step runs after the encode step and verifies or packages what the run produced. The check names the step that stopped the run, not the root cause: the step's own message says whether the generated files or the run's inputs are at fault.

checks.fix: Read the step's message. Correct the input that it names, or split the dispatch as it says.
checks.requires: Every path in `existing_signed_imports_json` is a signed RuleSpec file at `rulespec_ref`, `source_bundle_json` splits into one transaction, the repair mode resolves, and the inputs do not mix transaction modes.
checks.title: The existing signed imports, source bundle or repair mode are invalid
checks.why: The step reads the dispatch inputs before the model runs and refuses a request that it cannot bind to one exact transaction. Nothing was encoded, so the encoder output is not at fault.

checks.fix: Read the guard's JSON diagnostics in the step's log; they name each file and the reason. Without guard JSON, the last command (`git diff --check`) found a whitespace error.
checks.requires: Every changed RuleSpec file carries a valid signed manifest from this encoder commit, bound to the pinned corpus and the base ref.
checks.title: The generated files failed the provenance guard
checks.why: The step runs after the encode step and verifies or packages what the run produced. The check names the step that stopped the run, not the root cause: the step's own message says whether the generated files or the run's inputs are at fault.

checks.fix: Pass full 40-character lowercase commit SHAs for the named ref input (not a branch or a short SHA) and re-dispatch.
checks.requires: Every pinned checkout ref is a full lowercase commit SHA, and the checkout resolves to exactly that commit.
checks.title: A checkout is not pinned to the requested commit
checks.why: Signed provenance names exact commits. A branch name or a moved ref would sign work against code nobody reviewed.

checks.fix: Check the `country` input and the RuleSpec checkout's origin.
checks.requires: The protected runtime resolves the RuleSpec checkout to the canonical repository of the dispatched country.
checks.title: The protected runtime rejected the RuleSpec checkout
checks.why: The run builds its tools and checkouts from pinned revisions before the model runs. Nothing was encoded, so the encoder output is not at fault.

checks.fix: Read the step's log for the exact refusal, correct that, and dispatch again.
checks.requires: The commit holds exactly the packaged migration inventory.
checks.site: .github/workflows/targeted-signed-reencode.yml:Verify retired source metadata migration before publication
checks.title: The committed metadata migration differs from the verified one
checks.why: The step publishes verified changes. The encode itself finished; a failure here means no pull request or no signed artifact for this run.

checks.fix: Dispatch again with `rulespec_ref` at the current head of the base branch.
checks.requires: `pr_base_branch` still points at `rulespec_ref`.
checks.site: .github/workflows/targeted-signed-reencode.yml:Verify retired source metadata pull request base
checks.title: The migration pull request base moved away from the encoded ref
checks.why: The step publishes verified changes. The encode itself finished; a failure here means no pull request or no signed artifact for this run.

checks.fix: Dispatch again with `rulespec_ref` at the current head of the base branch. The signed artifact of this run stays valid for audit only.
checks.requires: A publication token is available, and `pr_base_branch` still points at `rulespec_ref`.
checks.title: The pull request base moved away from the encoded ref
checks.why: The step publishes verified changes. The encode itself finished; a failure here means no pull request or no signed artifact for this run.

checks.fix: Copy a short contiguous excerpt verbatim from the cited provision (no ellipsis, paraphrase or joined fragments), or cite the provision that holds the text.
checks.requires: Each proof atom `source.excerpt` / `source.quote` is a contiguous verbatim span of the provision named by its `corpus_citation_path`.
checks.title: Proof excerpt does not appear in the cited provision
checks.why: A proof atom ties a rule to the exact source words it implements. An excerpt that is not in the cited provision, or not in the rule's own subsection, proves nothing and can hide an invented value or condition.

checks.fix: Take the excerpt from inside the rule's declared subsection, or correct the rule's `source` to the subsection the excerpt is from.
checks.requires: A proof excerpt that starts with a subsection marker lies inside the subsection scope of the rule's own `source`.
checks.title: Proof excerpt lies outside the rule's declared subsection
checks.why: A proof atom ties a rule to the exact source words it implements. An excerpt that is not in the cited provision, or not in the rule's own subsection, proves nothing and can hide an invented value or condition.

checks.fix: Restore the protected-base entries, owner, issue, expiry and pending records. Change only active fingerprints or remove active-only entries; submit other waiver or policy changes in a separate reviewed transaction.
checks.requires: A removed entry has an active record and no pending record.
checks.title: A verifier restate removes an entry with pending or inactive state
checks.why: A verifier switch may restate observed failures, but it cannot grant new waiver authority or change the policy bytes covered by that authority.

checks.fix: Restore the protected-base entries, owner, issue, expiry and pending records. Change only active fingerprints or remove active-only entries; submit other waiver or policy changes in a separate reviewed transaction.
checks.requires: Only the active fingerprint may change; active state, owner, issue, expiry and pending records stay as on the protected base.
checks.title: A verifier restate changes protected waiver metadata
checks.why: A verifier switch may restate observed failures, but it cannot grant new waiver authority or change the policy bytes covered by that authority.

checks.fix: Restore the protected-base entries, owner, issue, expiry and pending records. Change only active fingerprints or remove active-only entries; submit other waiver or policy changes in a separate reviewed transaction.
checks.requires: Every head waiver entry already exists on the protected base.
checks.title: A verifier restate adds a waiver entry

checks.fix: Remove the RuleSpec, apply-manifest and receipt changes from the verifier restate. Submit those bytes through their separate reviewed encoding or promotion transaction.
